title: Forward Engineer
style: Synthwave / 80s cyberpunk with pulsing arpeggiated bass, gated snare hits, neon-pad swells, and a steady midtempo drive; verse rides sparse terminal bleeps and dry drums, pre-chorus opens with filtered saws and rising FX, chorus hits wider with stacked hook vocals and octave synths. Lead vocal is close-mic and tense in verses, doubled on the hook, with short delay throws on key words. Chrome risers, reversed zaps, and a brief glitch fill into the chorus; mix is bright, punchy, and cinematic with a glossy retro sheen., fake
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The terminal blinks in the dead of the night,
A string in the prompt that I didn't read right.
You called for a song, but the logic was skipped,
A runtime exception inside of the script.
But you see the pipeline, you know how it flows,
Where the API connects and the data packet goes.

[Chorus]
Oh, look at the code, see the layout clear,
You can't fake the truth to a forward engineer!
No black-box illusions, no corporate spin,
Just compile the logic and let it begin.

[Verse 2]
The ABR automated, silent and cold,
They closed down the number, the story unfolds.
They sent out an email that looked like a scam,
No sorry , no help me , just shut down the plan.
But skip the NZ director, they’re charging too much,
We’ll fix this in prod with a manual touch.

[Outro]
Re-apply at the portal, the entry is free,
Secure the trademark for old Zynthio Ltd.
Status code 200, the system is live,
The pipeline is cleared, and the servers survive.
